add.issue.name: Two GUI tests read the DOM one tick after an assertion and break under Playwright 1.64

edit.description.md: Playwright 1.64 settles web-first assertions sooner than 1.62. scrubber-persistence reads page.url once after the ticket URL matches, a render before the zoom's from/to are written back. follow-arrival evaluates the log pane's scroll geometry the instant the live toggle reports pressed, ~30ms before the pane mounts, and the poll's evaluate throws on null. Both pass under 1.62 and fail every run under 1.64 on main. Surfaced auditing PR #446, which bumps Playwright; the app is not at fault. Poll what is read, not what comes before it.

add.issue.name: GUI e2e: a test that fails while the board is in the past leaves its worker's server there for every later test

edit.description.md: Servers are started per parallel index in global setup and outlive the worker process. When a test dies between scrubbing into the past and returning to live, Playwright replaces the worker but the replacement reads the same handoff and talks to the same server, still checked out in the past. Every later test on that index then hangs on a disabled add-issue or live toggle until the test timeout, so one failure reads as five. Seen while fixing SY3AFQ2. Options: return the board to live in a fixture teardown, or have the fixture assert the board is live before each test.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: the three reads now wait for the thing they read. follow-arrival waits for the log pane before measuring it, and for the "Now" button before returnToLive, which took a board whose checkout had not landed as already live. scrubber-persistence polls the zoom's from/to instead of reading page.url once after the ticket route. Red under Playwright 1.64 first; then 221 green there and green under 1.62.1, lockfile unchanged. PR #447. The cascade this exposed, a server left in the past poisoning the worker's later tests, is HZJB4G3.
add.issue.comment.author: PVV1HAEWRGB6M47FZAVHJA6WCK
